name: Swift Switcher — Bulk & Custom Post Type Converter
author: Cupid Chakma

sections.description:
Swift Switcher is a powerful yet lightweight plugin that makes it incredibly easy to migrate posts from one post type to another — including custom post types. Whether you’re reorganizing your content or cleaning up your WordPress site structure, Swift Switcher helps you get the job done quickly, safely, and without any technical hassle.

🎯 Why Choose Swift Switcher?

Swift Switcher is designed for content managers, developers, and site admins who need flexibility and control over post types — without writing a single line of code. From small blogs to large content-heavy sites, this tool simplifies the entire process.

🚀 Features

✅ One-Click Post Type Conversion :-
Easily convert individual posts from one post type to another in seconds.

✅ Bulk Post Type Migration :-
Select and convert hundreds of posts in bulk with just a few clicks — perfect for large-scale content restructuring.

✅ Custom Post Type Support :-
Fully compatible with all registered post types, including custom ones created by themes or plugins.

✅ User-Friendly Interface :-
Clean, simple UI that integrates seamlessly into the WordPress admin dashboard under Swift Switcher.

✅ Safe and Non-Destructive :-
Your original content, metadata, and taxonomies remain intact during migration — only the post type changes.

✅ Free & Open Source:-
Free, transparent, flexible, secure, collaborative, ethical, empowering, sustainable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swift-switcher/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen by searching for ‘Swift Switcher’.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go ‘Swift Switcher’ to start migrating post types.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin affect my existing content?

No. Swift Switcher only changes the post type assigned to each post. Your post content, metadata, featured images, and categories/tags remain untouched.

Can I migrate custom post types?

Yes! The plugin works with any registered post type, including custom ones created via plugins or themes.

Does Swift Switcher support bulk actions?

Absolutely. You can select multiple posts and migrate them all at once using the Bulk Migration feature.

Is it safe to use on large websites?

Yes. Swift Switcher is optimized to process posts in batches, which prevents server overload and ensures smooth performance even on high-traffic or content-heavy websites.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

Not at all. Swift Switcher is built with ease-of-use in mind. If you can use WordPress, you can use Swift Switcher.

Can I undo a post type migration?

Currently, Swift Switcher does not have an automatic undo feature. However, since the content and metadata remain unchanged, you can manually switch the post types back using the same interface if needed.

Will my SEO settings or metadata be affected?

No. The plugin only changes the post type value. It does not modify your SEO metadata, slugs, custom fields, or plugin-specific settings like those from Yoast, Rank Math, or ACF.

Does Swift Switcher support Gutenberg and Classic Editor?

Yes. Swift Switcher is editor-agnostic — it works seamlessly whether you’re using the Gutenberg block editor or the Classic Editor.

Can I select individual posts for migration?

Yes! The Custom Migration feature lets you handpick specific posts for conversion, giving you complete control over which content is affected.

Is Swift Switcher multisite compatible?

Yes, the plugin works in a WordPress multisite environment. However, you’ll need to activate and use it on a per-site basis within the network.

Does this plugin support CPTs created by plugins like CPT UI or Toolset?

Yes, Swift Switcher detects and supports all properly registered custom post types — including those created by plugins like Custom Post Type UI, Pods, ACF, Toolset, and others.

Is the plugin free?

Yes! Swift Switcher is 100% free and open-source, licensed under GPL v2 or later. If you find it helpful, consider supporting development with a donation.
